additional_controls.name: Vision-LLM & Tabular Extraction Pipeline
additional_controls.purpose: Deterministic parser first; use Vision-LLM/document AI for complex CoAs, graphs and nested tables; output typed candidate JSON with original bytes, page rendering, coordinates and parser/model version. Unreadable/ambiguous/low confidence -> NEEDS_REVIEW/HOLD.

additional_controls.name: Deterministic Fallback & Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ)
additional_controls.purpose: Maximum 3 eligible idempotent retries with exponential backoff; noncritical draft/format/async tasks DLQ with run/revision/payload/reason/count; rule/manual verification for mandatory workflow while AI unavailable. No fabricated success or silent model substitution.

additional_controls.name: Data model / schema definition - MDM readiness
additional_controls.purpose: Product_ID, Batch_ID, Facility_ID, User_ID preserve local IDs and accept external_uuid, external_system, mapping_status (UNMAPPED/MATCHED/CONFLICT/RETIRED), mapping history/effective timestamps. Tenant/purpose/authorization before joins. Correlation key does not grant authority.

additional_controls.name: Human Authority & Finalization - E-Signature Gateway
additional_controls.purpose: Password+OTP or approved biometric second factor; reason for signature; exact dossier/export revision and manifest hash; UTC signer audit. Material change needs re-review/re-sign; stale/hash mismatch/auth failure -> HOLD/REAUTHENTICATE/RE-REVIEW. Part 11 oriented control, not compliance certification.

nonnegotiable_boundaries: One deterministic parent owns authorization, idempotency, persistence, waits, retries, state transitions and controlled writes.
Agents perform bounded candidate work; exhausted work is visible HOLD/EXHAUSTED.
Author A10 differs from independent QC A11 and human approver; A17 cannot self-close.
Exact source/version/span required for accepted facts and material statements; missing remains missing.
Original bytes/raw values never overwritten by normalization/model output; corrections create revisions.
Human authority determines scientific comparability, reporting, batch disposition and release; no autonomous regulated disposition.
Evidence/data/rule/model/workflow material changes invalidate only affected decisions, preserving historical state and evidence-backed non-impact.
Frozen scientific fixtures and actual denominators required; synthetic engineering tests do not establish independent RA accuracy or customer outcomes.
No regulatory acceptance, GxP/Part 11 validation, production security, real-world ROI or world-first claim without separate evidence.
Cross-tenant object/row/vector/export access prohibited; membership revocation after pauses checked.
Raw originals, metadata, lineage, coordinates, parser/model/prompt versions preserved before analysis.
No client secrets, proprietary/company/patient records or confidential analytics without permission and controls.
